title: HCFCD Utility Crossing Land Use
permit_name: Land Use Request or Easement Sale for Utility Crossing

permits.name: Land Use Request or Easement Sale for Utility Crossing

explanations.trigger_explanation: Using Harris County Flood Control District property for a utility crossing commonly triggers a land use request and, where the district owns fee title, an easement sale pathway.

known_unknowns: The district uses different property-rights instruments depending on whether the request is temporary access, an agreement, an easement sale, or an abandonment.
advisories: Additional review recommended early because district property-rights path selection can affect schedule, legal documents, and survey requirements.
notes: Confidence tier 2 because the district clearly publishes the property-rights pathways, but the exact instrument depends on ownership status and the permanent or temporary nature of the utility use.
